reasoning.summary: As of October 10, 2026, no numeric patches qualify for recommendation. Verified World Gold Council research published October 7 describes September yield, dollar and futures-positioning pressures, but monthly associations do not establish an M15 ATR/structure management edge or calibrate any allowed parameter. ([gold.org](https://www.gold.org/goldhub/research/gold-market-commentary-september-2026?utm_source=openai)) The supplied Federal Reserve stress-test release concerns bank capital-requirement volatility, not gold-price volatility; it is not evidence for widening stops. ([federalreserve.gov](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260930a.htm)) The supplied FRED errors leave contemporaneous macro observations unavailable. Current parameter values, parameter semantics, trade timestamps, execution costs and trade-level adverse/favorable excursions are missing, so an absolute numeric patch cannot be verified as small or conservative. Prioritize pvt102 for loss-tail investigation: its 66.67% signal win rate accompanies -1430.35 net pips and -1.919R; larger average losing risk is descriptive, not proof that lowering maxRiskATR would help. snd107 requires inves
